messages:
aj: quick heads-up — packaging found a checksum drift on redwood-offline-installer-v1.12.0+rev2.tar.gz for private/vpc. I'm holding the deploybot canary scheduled for tonight.
maria: ugh, details? what drift — gzip? tar ordering?
jun: looks like gzip compression level difference + file mtime not normalized. sha256 doesn't match signer output. example: 
```
$ sha256sum artifacts/redwood-offline-installer-v1.12.0+rev2.tar.gz
3f7a9b2c8e5d4a6b7c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3  redwood-offline-installer-v1.12.0+rev2.tar.gz
```
jun: cosign verify failed: 
```
$ cosign verify --key kms://projects/…/keys/release-signer artifacts/redwood-offline-installer-v1.12.0+rev2.tar.gz
error: signature not found: verification failed
```
aj: deploybot posted the scheduled canary at 2026-03-21T03:00Z; I paused it. deploybot: canary_start_at=2026-03-21T03:00Z status=PAUSED (reason=artifact-checksum-mismatch)
ops_karen: options: 1) rebuild deterministic rev2 now (takes ~20m), re-sign and re-run canary; 2) fall back to v1.12.0+rev1 (already signed) for tonight's canary and repack rev2 in next window; 3) abort canary and ship no release (bad for downstream customers).
maria: prefer option 2 — keep SLA for canary but don't risk failed deploy. who can do the deterministic rebuild?
jun: I can run a deterministic pack script but need a clean build env and to pin gzip -n and tar --mtime. will start if we agree.
sre_dan: if we revert to rev1 for canary, we need a manifest pin + note in release notes about repack. Also ensure deploybot fallback rules will not auto-promote the old artifact later.
aj: decision: revert to rev1 for tonight's canary; jun will repack rev2 in the 04:30 UTC maintenance window and we'll re-run an off-hours dry-run. action items: 
- [jun] Run deterministic repack + cosign with KMS and upload to S3 (deadline 04:50 UTC)
- [aj] Update manifests to pin v1.12.0+rev1 for canary and set deploybot to use pinned artifact (done before 02:50 UTC)
- [maria] Update release_notes.md with checksum and repack notes
- [sre_dan] Monitor canary and be ready to abort if rollout errors > 5%

jun: starting rebuild now. using: 
```
GZIP=-n make package-offline VERSION=1.12.0 REV=rev2-deterministic
sha256sum dist/redwood-offline-installer-v1.12.0+rev2-deterministic.tar.gz
cosign sign --key kms://projects/…/release-signer dist/...tar.gz
```
jun: halfway — build environment found an extra symlink, fixed. continuing.
aj: I've pushed manifest pin: 
```
artifact_manifest:
  redwood-offline-installer: "1.12.0+rev1"
```
deploybot: canary scheduled -> PAUSED -> manifest pin applied, will now use pinned artifact.
maria: pushed a small blurb to release_notes: "Canary will use v1.12.0+rev1 due to packaging checksum drift on tentative rev2. Rev2 will be repacked and re-signed in maintenance window; customers on private deployments will be notified if they opt into rev2."
sre_dan: ok I'm watching metrics. will call abort if error spike.
jun: repack complete and cosign succeeded. checksums: 
```
sha256sum dist/redwood-offline-installer-v1.12.0+rev2-deterministic.tar.gz
3f7a9b2c8e5d4a6b7c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a4  redwood-offline-installer-v1.12.0+rev2-deterministic.tar.gz
cosign verify --key kms://projects/…/release-signer dist/...
Verified OK
```
aj: next steps: we will not flip the canary tonight; we will run a staged deploybot dry-run against staging for rev2 tomorrow morning and then schedule a controlled canary next change window. ops_karen please coordinate customer comms for private deliveries.
ops_karen: noted. sending notice to account contacts with optional rev2 early access opt-in and linking the new checksum & cosign attestation.
maria: tagging this thread into changelog and release board. thanks all. :thumbsup:
deploybot: NOTE: manual action taken by aj — canary remains using pinned artifact v1.12.0+rev1. scheduled_repack=rev2-deterministic status=SIGNED_UPLOADED
